workflows.example: Add a CSV export to the existing orders screen. Include filtered rows, preserve their displayed order, and verify the exported values locally.
workflows.finish: The requested behavior works on the tested candidate; relevant checks and review are reconciled. Design and TDD apply when their seams are settled.

workflows.goal: Reproduce, diagnose, and fix a bug
workflows.example: Reproduce the duplicate final CSV row, identify its root cause, then fix it and verify the boundary cases. Preserve unrelated work.
workflows.finish: A reproduction establishes the cause; the accepted fix passes a focused regression check. A diagnosis-only request stops before implementation.

workflows.example: Review this diff read-only for correctness and maintainability. Cite concrete evidence and leave the files unchanged.
workflows.finish: Findings identify the candidate, location, impact, and supporting evidence. Repair remains a separate outcome.

workflows.example: Verify order export in the permitted local stack. Reuse the existing feature map and harness, exercise the real user path, retain evidence, and clean up only the instance you started.
workflows.finish: The execution owner records PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, or NOT RUN for each selected entry point, with candidate identity and evidence surviving teardown.

workflows.example: Model the export job's queued, running, cancelled, and completed states. With the reviewed local checker, check that cancelled jobs never publish a result and explain any counterexample.
workflows.finish: The model maps to source and each property has its own result, bounds, and gaps. Rendering a chart alone does not establish correctness.

workflows.example: Repair the known CI failure on this PR, preserve its intended scope, and verify the published head. Do not merge it.
workflows.finish: Known findings and CI blockers have evidence-backed dispositions for the final head. The status watcher reports observations and grants no merge authority.
